user.title: Aruba Device Tracker
user.description:
Enter the connection details for your Aruba Instant AP.

Make sure REST API is enabled on the IAP.

data_description.host: IP address of your Aruba IAP or Virtual Controller (e.g. 192.168.1.10)

tracking.title: Tracking & Polling
tracking.description: Configure polling and automatic cleanup. You will choose the clients exposed to Home Assistant on the next step.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to query the IAP for connected clients. Min 10s, max 300s.
data_description.cleanup_enabled: Automatically remove devices not seen for the configured number of days.
data_description.cleanup_days: Number of days without activity before a device entity is removed.

devices.title: Select devices to track
devices.description: Only selected clients will be created as device tracker entities. Newly discovered clients remain available here and are not added automatically.

data_description.tracked_devices: Select every Aruba client that should be visible in Home Assistant. Leave empty to expose none.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Aruba IAP. Check the IP address, confirm the device is online, and that REST API is enabled with 'allow-rest-api'.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the username and password.
error.api_access_denied: Login succeeded but the account cannot run API commands. Ensure the user has full management privileges, not read-only.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Aruba IAP is already configured.

init.title: Aruba IAP Settings
init.description: Update connection details, polling, cleanup, and the clients exposed to Home Assistant. Unselected clients remain discoverable and can be selected later.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to query the IAP for connected clients. Min 10s, max 300s.
data_description.cleanup_enabled: Automatically remove devices not seen for the configured number of days.
data_description.cleanup_days: Number of days without activity before a device entity is removed.
data_description.tracked_devices: Only selected clients get a device tracker entity. Removing a selection deletes its entity; select it again to restore it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Aruba IAP at the new address. Check the IP and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed with the new credentials.
error.api_access_denied: Login succeeded but the account cannot run API commands. Use a full-privilege management account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
